verdict.rationale: First-party docs show FreshBooks creates invoices with tracked time, expenses and taxes, plus customizable online payment options: cards, ACH, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Buy Now, Pay Later. Payment status is supported through the Payments and Online Payments APIs, a Payments Collected report, and invoice webhooks. Missing for 10: any evidence of invoice-viewed tracking or client view notifications, explicit documentation of the send/email-invoice flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
